_comment: Machine-readable lock for Jaune's external bootstrap inputs. Consumed by scripts/env_doctor.py and (from Step 2 onward) the bootstrap tooling. Documented in scripts/vectors/SOURCES.md. Do not duplicate these literals elsewhere; update this file and let consumers read it.

execution_specs._comment: Legacy BlockchainTests fixtures live under <root>/tests/fixtures/ethereum_tests, an independent nested checkout (see ethereum_tests below), not an execution-specs submodule.

ethereum_tests._comment: Ignored by execution-specs' .gitignore; not tracked as a Git submodule of execution-specs.

eest._comment_env_var: EEST_ROOT names the top-level install directory containing the archive and its extracted fixtures/ tree. It is distinct from scripts/check-legacy.sh's JAUNE_FIXTURES, which instead points directly at a tier's leaf fixture directory (and already defaults to <EEST_ROOT>/fixtures/blockchain_tests for --bls). The two variables are not interchangeable.
eest._comment_layout: Every member of the archive is a regular file whose path begins with the fixtures_subpath prefix, so extracting into <EEST_ROOT> yields <EEST_ROOT>/fixtures/. The archive contains no directory, symlink, hardlink, or special members; the safe extractor and deep verifier reject anything else.
eest._comment_metadata: Release-identity fields recorded inside the archive's own .meta/fixtures.ini ([fixtures] section). Fast-mode verification confirms the extracted tree carries this exact provenance; the values are pinned here rather than derived from release_tag because the upstream git ref (tests-v5.4.0) differs from the release download tag (v5.4.0).

current_mainnet._comment: The v21.0.1 mainnet fixture release. Both lanes pin this release; the conformance target descends from its commit (conformance_target.fixture_release_commit); suites and manifests remain separate. Identity verified against the official release API and checksum-verified archive.

conformance_target._comment: The transition-tool conformance anchor for `jaune t8n`, chosen 2026-08-03 because this checkout's `fill` defaults to the in-process ExecutionSpecsTransitionTool, which calls this same checkout's EELS in process (client_clis/__init__.py sets the default tool; clis/execution_specs.py runs T8N.run). It is a GATE ANCHOR, not a fork-scope commitment: `fork_lane` is the block-validation handshake of canonical static target names advertised by `jaune t8n --forks`, derived from the build's runnable general forks through T8n.targetForkName?: Petersburg is spelled ConstantinopleFix, and synthetic EIP-1283 Constantinople has no target name and is omitted. scripts/check-cli.sh pins that the binary and this list agree and that every advertised name resolves before input; every label on it resolves through the one resolver `Fork.rules?` (the separate transaction-metering vehicle that `--state.fork Amsterdam` once resolved, and whose omitted block semantics `--info` once named, was retired by goal C). No BPO3-5 path is selected. This checkout is SEPARATE from execution_specs above -- that one is the frozen oracle pin for check-fake-exp.sh and the vector generators, and is never repointed. This one has its own venv (`uv sync --no-default-groups --group test`), which scripts/gen-t8n-goldens.py and scripts/check-t8n.sh drive.
conformance_target._comment_repin: History: the predecessor used the devnet-8 release. Goal jaune-amsterdam-readiness-v1 moves both fixture lanes and this anchor to tests@v21.0.1 (1562e2f); the four framework-side wrapper paths are carried in commit 9fc6c99c1. The frozen execution_specs oracle above is unchanged. Goal devcon8-talk-v1 (user decision devcon8-t8n-pin-split-20261022) moves this anchor alone to forks/bogota 9154c29e, the merge of ethereum/execution-specs#3361, which also carries #3849: the tool now numbers its output by accepted transactions and its body lists only those. No fixture release carries both fixes, so the two fixture lanes stay at tests@v21.0.1 and the same-commit rule becomes descent: fixture_release_commit must be an ancestor of commit (both generators check it against the checkout, and scripts/tests/test_amsterdam_lane.py checks it names the lanes' release). The fork-constant extraction is taken at commit while the fixture lanes run at fixture_release_commit, so a constant that differed between the two would fail either check-fork-constants.sh or the fixture lanes. uv_version is this checkout's own uv requirement (it refuses uv < 0.13.4), separate from the frozen oracle's. Re-unify all three pins at the next tests@ mainnet release that contains both fixes. Historical ommer reward summaries use the separately registered ommer-reward-summary-cli-v1 projection before typed environment validation; its exact CLI bytes and actual checkout identity are recorded per generated case. This compatibility projection does not change the semantic target revision.

python_oracle._comment: Python 3.11.9 is an exact requirement, not merely a 3.11-series preference: the oracle includes native extension wheels and its generated bytes are accepted only from the tested interpreter/package closure. The complete 18-package runtime closure is hash-locked in requirements_lock. execution-specs itself is intentionally absent from that lock; generators import from the separately manifest-pinned checkout, avoiding a machine-local path entry.

amsterdam._comment: The v21.0.1 mainnet fixture release. Both lanes pin this release; the conformance target descends from its commit (conformance_target.fixture_release_commit); suites and manifests remain separate. Identity verified against the official release API and checksum-verified archive.

legacy_restoration._comment: Owner-approved unmerged restoration pin for the G8 historical corpus inventory, installed separately from the frozen ethereum/tests LegacyTests gitlink. These Cancun/Constantinople files contain no Prague cases and do not replace the Prague BlockchainTests gate or its baseline; the separate ethereum/tests EIP-7610 mismatch remains a recorded G8 finding.
